extraction.Name: Frank Sully
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded June 5, 1918, by Frank Sully
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to Drovers Cattle Loan & Investment Company for $15,898.00 on December 19, 1917 (before issuance of patent); mortgage released July 5, 1919; Frank Sully conveyed the land to Mary E. Jeppesen for $12,000 on July 5, 1919
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612783 issued; Northeast quarter section 32, township 99, range 74; receipt for patent signed February 11, 1918 by Frank Sully; mortgage was on December 19, 1917 before issuance of patent; mortgage released July 5, 1919; In 1913 a Lis pendens was filed against Frank Sully by Joe Kirby, probably owing to the law suit which the Sullys were in at that time trying to get their allotments; document dated June 1929
